{{Quote|Haldo was one of the men on my crew. My guess is that his rebreather wasn't working properly and he breathed too much of the alum fumes.|[[Japer Witter]]|<ref name="SWG:JW">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Japer Witter|Endor}}</ref>}}
'''Haldo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated in the [[alum]] mines below the [[Death Watch bunker]], working for [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] [[Japer Witter]].<ref name="SWG" />
